title: spec + i18n: register the ask agent tool get_record_history (cloud#4347) in PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE and add its chatbot.tool label to every locale pack
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Filing gate: ④ the platform half of a cloud card (cloud#4347, cross-repo-coordination rule 1). The cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#4374 is otherwise complete and waits on this registration, then on a pin bump.

## 维护者速读

cloud 给问答助手加了一个只读工具 `get_record_history`：读当前用户有权看的那条记录的修改历史，用来「撤销上一次修改」，恢复仍然走确认卡。框架的平台工具名登记表要先列上这个名字，各语言包要加上它的显示名，cloud 的一致性测试才能通过。改动很小：一行登记加 14 个语言包里各一个标签。

## Work

1. `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts`: add `get_record_history` to `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']` (~L58-70 on main), following the file's own maintenance rule (its header).
2. `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (14 packs on main): add `chatbot.tool.get_record_history` beside `open_record` (en.ts ~L4853 has `open_record: 'Open the record'`). Suggested en: 'Read record history'. Translate per pack.
3. Whatever conformance or ledger test in this repo pins the registry list (the registry header names it).

`Clause-②`: the dev measures. A new name in a published constant list widens it, so likely `yes`.

## Acceptance

The name is listed and each locale pack carries the label. Then cloud's `platform-tool-names-conformance.test.ts` on #4374 passes after the pin bump that carries this change.

Reader: the lane owning `packages/spec/src/system/constants` (spec), with ui i18n in the same PR or a twin.

Dedupe: `get_record_history` → 0 hits in this repository (seat grep on main).
